notes: EXAMPLE denylist — replace with your own private terms. Client codes match case-SENSITIVE word-boundary (case-insensitive matching of short month/hour-shaped codes produces catastrophic false positives against date placeholders such as YYYY-MM-DD; use the optional per-entry regex override to add adjacency negation). Domains and identifiers match as substrings. Every term maps to a generic replacement; any post-strip hit fails the export.

client_codes.note: adjacency negation example: a two-letter code that must not match inside hyphen/colon-joined placeholders
